feature.name: Fast & Reliable Delivery
feature.shortDescription: We ensure fast and reliable delivery across multiple locations. Our trusted logistics partners make sure your orders reach your doorstep safely and on time, giving you a smooth and stress-free shopping experience every time.

feature.name: Secure Payments
feature.shortDescription: Shop with confidence using our secure payment system. We support trusted payment gateways with advanced encryption to protect your personal and financial data, ensuring safe transactions through cards, UPI, wallets, and net banking.

feature.name: Easy Returns
feature.shortDescription: Not satisfied with your purchase? Our easy return policy allows hassle-free returns and exchanges. We believe in customer satisfaction and make sure the return process is simple, transparent, and quick.

feature.name: Wide Product Range
feature.shortDescription: Explore a wide range of products across categories including men, women, kids, and more. We carefully curate our collection to offer quality, style, and variety—so you always find what you’re looking for.

feature.name: Quality Assurance
feature.shortDescription: Every product goes through strict quality checks before being listed. We partner with trusted brands and sellers to ensure you receive durable, authentic, and high-quality products that meet your expectations.

feature.name: Affordable Pricing
feature.shortDescription: Get the best value for your money with competitive pricing and regular discounts. Our goal is to make quality products affordable without compromising on standards, helping you shop smart every day.

feature.name: User-Friendly Experience
feature.shortDescription: Our website is designed for simplicity and ease of use across all devices. From browsing products to checkout, every step is smooth and intuitive, making online shopping fast and enjoyable for everyone.

feature.name: Verified Sellers
feature.shortDescription: We work only with verified and trusted sellers to maintain product authenticity and service quality. This ensures transparency, reliability, and peace of mind while shopping on our platform.

feature.name: Exclusive Offers
feature.shortDescription: Enjoy exclusive deals, seasonal discounts, and special offers available only on our platform. Subscribe to notifications and newsletters so you never miss exciting savings and limited-time promotions.

feature.name: Order Tracking
feature.shortDescription: Track your orders in real time from dispatch to delivery. Our order tracking feature keeps you updated at every step, giving you full visibility and confidence about your purchase status.

feature.name: Trusted by Customers
feature.shortDescription: Thousands of happy customers trust us for their online shopping needs. Genuine reviews, ratings, and repeat customers reflect our commitment to quality service and long-term customer satisfaction.

feature.name: 24/7 Customer Support
feature.shortDescription: Our dedicated support team is available to assist you anytime. Whether you have questions about products, orders, or returns, we’re always here to provide quick and helpful solutions.

faq.question: How can I place an order?
faq.answer: You can place an order by selecting your desired product, choosing the size or variant, adding it to your cart, and proceeding to checkout. Follow the payment steps to confirm your order successfully.

faq.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer: We accept multiple payment options including Debit/Credit Cards, UPI, Net Banking, Wallets, and Cash on Delivery (where available).

faq.question: How long does delivery take?
faq.answer: Delivery usually takes 3–7 business days depending on your location. You will receive tracking details once your order is shipped.

faq.question: Can I track my order?
faq.answer: Yes, once your order is dispatched, you will receive a tracking link via email or SMS to monitor your delivery status in real time.

faq.question: What is your return policy?
faq.answer: We offer an easy return policy within a specific number of days after delivery. Products must be unused and in original packaging to be eligible.

faq.question: How do I cancel my order?
faq.answer: You can cancel your order from your account before it is shipped. If already shipped, you may request a return after delivery.

faq.question: Are the products genuine?
faq.answer: Yes, we ensure that all products listed on Apni Shop are quality-checked and sourced from trusted and verified sellers.

faq.question: Do you offer refunds?
faq.answer: Yes, once your returned product is inspected and approved, the refund will be processed to your original payment method within a few working days.

faq.question: Is my payment information secure?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We use secure and encrypted payment gateways to protect your personal and financial information.

faq.question: How can I contact customer support?
faq.answer: You can contact our support team via email, phone, or the contact form available on our website. Our team is always ready to assist you.

At Apni Shop, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit or make a purchase from our website.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

Personal Information

  • Full Name
  • Email Address
  • Phone Number
  • Shipping & Billing Address
  • Payment Details (processed securely via payment gateways)

Non-Personal Information

  • Browser type
  • IP address
  • Device information
  • Cookies and usage data

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Process and deliver your orders
  • Send order confirmations and updates
  • Improve our website and services
  • Provide customer support
  • Send promotional emails (if subscribed)
  • Prevent fraud and enhance security

3. Payment Security

All payment transactions are processed through secure, encrypted payment gateways. We do not store your card details on our servers.

4. Cookies

We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, remember your preferences, and analyze website traffic. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

5. Data Protection

We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.

6. Third-Party Services

We may share limited information with trusted third parties such as:

  • Payment gateways
  • Delivery partners
  • Marketing tools

These parties are obligated to protect your information.

7. Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access your personal data
  • Request correction or deletion
  • Opt-out of marketing emails

For any requests, contact us at: vishankchauhan@gmail.com

8. Policy Updates

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page.

1. Return Eligibility

Products are eligible for return if:

  • Requested within 7 days of delivery
  • Item is unused and in original packaging
  • Original invoice is available

Items not eligible:

  • Used or damaged products
  • Innerwear (if applicable)
  • Customized items

  • Submit a return request via your account or contact support.
  • Our team will review and approve the request.
  • Pickup will be scheduled (if available).

  • Refunds will be processed after product inspection.

  • Orders can be cancelled before shipment.
  • Once shipped, cancellation is not possible, but you may request a return after delivery.
